description:
Seems to check if a trusted application needs an update and downloads it.
This package probably does more than that. There is a LOT of lines of code (obfuscated obviously)
It was used to push an update to fix a security issue with the fingerprint sensor in 2019.
https://libredd.it/r/galaxys10/comments/bcy93f/adb_how_to_get_the_fingerprint_update_pushed_to/
Seems to be only used for biometrics stuff
There is Samsung analytics inside. You may want to remove it if you don't use biometrics authentication.
